entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hello, Sarah. I'm calling about an order I received a few weeks ago. I'd like to start a return for the Aero Race Jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Miller, and the order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the Aero Race Jersey, delivered on January 2nd. I just need to confirm, is there a technical fault with the item or is it more of a preference issue?
It's a preference issue. I ordered my usual size, but this specific jersey is just the wrong size for me. It's far too tight in the shoulders.
I understand completely. Not a problem at all. I see you're well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right away. You'll get a full refund.

That's great, thank you. Now, I am planning to order the next size up. Since I have to go through the hassle of packaging this up and ordering a new one, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for the new purchase?

That's a reasonable request. Let me check what I can do for you. ... Yes, I see here you're one of our VIP customers. For the inconvenience, I can absolutely add a 15% discount to your account. You can use that on your next order, whether you want to exchange for a different size or get something else entirely.
A 15% discount works perfectly. I appreciate you doing that. Thank you, Sarah.

You're very welcome, Alex. I've just sent the prepaid return label to your email on file for the jersey. And the discount is now active on your account. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful.
Wonderful. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
